name: collagen type VII alpha 1 chain

function.text: COL7A1 encodes collagen alpha-1(VII) chain. Annotated molecular activities include serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity and extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength. It participates in cell adhesion and epidermis development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (autosomal recessive); dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
